blocks.text: THE HEAVENS DECLARE - The News (with pictures) reported a celestial wonder occurred Dec. 1 - 8, 1997. “It revealed a strange formation of 7 heavenly planets and then added to this the sun was also involved as the moon made a pointing to it,” (nine bodies altogether). It said you would see an occurrence like this only once in a life time! And what a year from the beginning to the end. The Scripts mentioned at the beginning of 1997, bad moon rising, and now the year ends with this unusual phenomenon concerning the moon! (Jesus gives us a view in Luke 21:25)

THE YEAR 1998 - will be a mysterious, deceptive and more of the unexpected with sudden surprises! Religion, politics, and society will undergo another cycle! Evidently a year of great quakes, violence, also including erratic weather and nature, impatience, and perplexity! ‘“-But Jesus has promised His children peace in the midst of persecution and chaos!” - Also in first part of 1998, two important heavenly bodies will be moving! - Then Feb. 26, will be a total solar eclipse to start the year off. Giving signs of His nearness and the soon rising of a new world system! - Jesus, Himself said look up, for your redemption draweth nigh! (Luke 21:28)

FANTASTIC AND INCREDIBLE events and sights - appearing in the near future and years ahead! Plus concerning the heavenly phenomenon we will list a few - 1998 will shew forth mysteries in space! Another rare and important event takes place. The Neptune and Pluto shift! This started in 1979 and brings them back to their proper position concerning the (sun & etc.) in March 1999. This shift only occurs about every 247 years! - We did see some powerful structural changes, etc. - The Reagan shooting, changing parties etc. and effects on all nations! - In July - August 1999 will be some very unusual planetary movements, plus a great eclipse! Let me say this, powerful events will loom from this day forward! The earth had better be prepared! There will be great star showers and fire balls near this date! - Also May 5, 2000 there is an unusual grand alignment of planets. These various celestial wonders are not all by accident, but very significant warnings!

CONTINUING - We can only list a very small part of what is going to take place in the heavens soon! - We see in the Old Testament God spoke of signs. - Judges 5:20, They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera. — PS. chap. 19 — — (Also fearful sights and wonders in Luke 21:11) - The autumn of 2001 - 2003 inters a tremendous earth cycle! We might add that Scr. #178 was a real classic of the spirit. As we see it pointed out from the early 1990’s until now and beyond what occurred!

MANS TOWER OF BABEL - The USA wants to complete the large International space station by 2003. - “Jesus is showing the elect the signs of the heavens! (Read Obah.1:4) - They put robot vehicles on Mars and said they would go back again! The ancients always said Mars was associated to a god of war and strife! - They have sent a platinum satellite to reach the planet Saturn by 2004. The ancients noticed Saturn is associated to woe, chaos and division! “By all of this the Lord is showing us a terrible crisis is coming beforehand and evidently the Tribulation is very close! - “Jesus is telling us to prepare right now! The elect could leave sooner than you think! Be prepared at all times!” - Some powerful influences will leap forth before the century ends!

IMPORTANT FACTORS - Part of these Scriptures we list here are beginning to take place now and the other parts of Scriptures will take place beyond 2000. - Rev. 17:3, So he carried me away in he spirit into the wilderness : and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns. — She is now beginning to dominate the earth for a short time and soon fornicate with all nations! And later burnt with atomic fire. (Vr. 16) This Scripture has begun. Hag. 2:6-7, For thus saith the LORD of hosts; Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the LORD of hosts. Before this latter part He will cause an earth axis tilt evidently cross-

THE APOCALYPTIC RIDER - This mysterious rider of peace and deception will begin before or by the year 2000 - This system is already setting things in motion! He will be revealed soon! - Rev. 6:2, And I saw, and behold a white horse; and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer. — The pale horse will finish up on the other side of the century at some appointed time. (read vrs. 1 - 8)

FIRE IN THE SKY - Some fire balls have already struck the earth as predicted. But this chapter is going to continue into greater dimensions and larger on the other side. Rev. 8:7 The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up. The rest of the chapter is catastrophic with dark omens! — The two witness (Rev.11) will appear around the time Rev. 8 starts! Rev. 13 is being prepared even now to control the world sometime at God’s appointed time!

WE won’t print these, but these other Scriptures will follow later after the above. Rev. chap. 9 - Rev. chap 16 — The earth will be visited by atomic chill after destructive cosmic fire loads of missiles, by space, subs, and earth weapons. Cosmic darkness will cover the world as Jesus intervenes at Armageddon, or no flesh saved! Sometime after the year 2000 - 2007 the earth will practically be a waste land.

WHAT AN HOUR - In the midst of apostasy the former and latter rain are gathering His people in the final chapter! The midnight cry is here! “His outstretched hand of salvation and miracles are occurring everywhere!” - The writing of His Word will produce the divine love and anointing; it will cause us to be caught up in the Translation! Be ready! - Be praying for you daily. At a certain point He will immediately put in the sickle and the elect harvest is ending. (Mark 4:29)
Note: 1998 - 2000 some of our greatest storms, tidal waves, super quakes, famine and volcanic activity will begin! - Let us all pray and say surely the Lord cometh quickly!
